title: Strawberry
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='berryGrad' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b6b'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ee2a2a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b81212'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='shineGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9e9e' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff9e9e' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- strawberry body -->
  <path d='M50 92 C30 92 14 74 14 56 C14 40 26 28 42 26 C46 25.5 50 26 54 26 C70 28 86 40 86 56 C86 74 70 92 50 92 Z' fill='url(#berryGrad)'/>

  <ellipse cx='36' cy='44' rx='13' ry='16' fill='url(#shineGrad)' transform='rotate(-20 36 44)'/>

  <g fill='#ffe9a8'>

    <ellipse cx='58' cy='70' rx='2' ry='3.2'/>

    <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='2' ry='3.2'/>

    <ellipse cx='78' cy='56' rx='1.6' ry='2.6' transform='rotate(30 78 56)'/>

  <!-- strawberry body top shading -->
  <path d='M42 26 C46 25.5 50 26 54 26 C62 27 68 32 72 38 C62 32 54 30 50 30 C46 30 38 32 28 38 C32 32 36 27 42 26 Z' fill='#ff8a6a' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- leaves -->

  <path d='M48 27 C44 23 38 20 32 21 C37 22 43 25 48 28 Z' fill='#7ee07e' opacity='0.7'/>
